propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and sibling absence/tombstone/comment operations to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the test's blast radius narrowed and would miss regressions where moved operations unconditionally stamp updated_at.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass because both call sites gate on out-of-window-but-alive keys, making AC#2 mutation verification impossible without extending the test harness.
The no-stamp contract for clear_absent is already pinned at unit tier via test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, containing the risk from the narrowed integration oracle.
